_doc: v1.3 voice registry. f0 = voice_f0.json (7B, 3-speaker). credit = line added to notes + chapters.txt by post_episode.ps1 when the voice is in the cast. Blocked voices are refused by vv7b_generate.py / pick_cast.py.

Clara.credit: Voice credit: the voice of Clara is synthesized from a reference recording of LibriTTS-R speaker 84 (Y. Koizumi et al., "LibriTTS-R: A Restored Multi-Speaker Text-to-Speech Corpus", Interspeech 2023; CC BY 4.0, https://www.openslr.org/141/), derived from public-domain LibriVox recordings.

pool._doc: v1.3 (clarified 2026-10-15): NO default cast. Only the host is fixed (Carter unless Thomas says otherwise). Guests are picked at random per episode by pick_cast.py from this pool (Frank, Clara, Isla, Marcus, Declan, Willa, Zara, Imogen, Elliot, Hugh, Lachlan; Samuel weight 0.25; Maya excluded 15 Oct per Thomas, override only), respecting script gender and a >= 12 Hz F0 gap to host and to the other guest. Willa..Lachlan added 15 Oct (VCTK, CC BY 4.0, credit auto-added).
